title: Update one attribute
summary: UpdateItem can change selected attributes at a key.
introduction: UpdateItem can change selected attributes at a key. Your task: Add a condition requiring the reader attribute to exist.
learningObjectives: Add a condition requiring the reader attribute to exist.
Explain the example for update one attribute

blocks.text: UpdateItem can change selected attributes at a key. Expression names and values keep field names and data separate from the expression.

Use DynamoDB Local and the AWS CLI or SDK in a separate practice project. Point every command at http://localhost:8000. Low-level JSON examples show request bodies; provide them to the matching CLI command or SDK method.
Read the code step by step

items: `UpdateExpression` states the attribute changes. It is separate from the key that selects the item.
`ExpressionAttributeNames` maps placeholders such as #reader to actual field names in the request expression.
`ExpressionAttributeValues` passes typed data separately from the expression text.

blocks.text: The local update returns the item with pages changed to 64.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: UpdateItem can create an item if it is missing. Add an existence condition when an update must require an old item.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a condition requiring the reader attribute to exist.
